contract: Whole-workspace synchronization with authenticated private peer archive transfer, archive integrity/member validation and joint content-conflict merge barrier
limitations: Recovered execution; destination files may reuse valid materialization from an earlier preparation. This is not a controlled cold-workspace benchmark.
Joint preparation and merge durations are shared barriers and must each be counted once, not once per dependency.
Server payload bytes exclude control-plane SSH traffic. Archive bytes still traverse the cloud private network.
Consumer timestamps measure the observed task interval, not independently verified native Docker compute duration.
This validates a transfer path and consumer barrier, not completion of the entire 58-activity campaign.
